column1: # Ozone Vibe GT: the rigging diagram, line by line.
# Source: Ozone, "Vibe GT Rigging Diagram" (Vibe_GT_rigging_diagram.pdf, Adobe
#   Illustrator, one A3 page), supplied by the user 2026-09-29.
# Transcribed 2026-10-19 from the drawing: each line and the line it hangs
#   from. A parent that is not a line is where the cascade ends: a riser, or
#   the brake handle. "A2" is the drawing's A-squared riser, the split A.
# The same in every size: the sheets vibegt-XS.tsv to vibegt-XL.tsv carry
#   these names, and the unit suite holds the two to each other.
